A direct Floquet/Jury analysis of the alternating BDF5 recurrence gives zero-stability exactly when

\[
r+\frac1r \le u_*,
\]

where \(u_*\) is the unique root \(>2\) of

\[
4u^3-8u^2-95u-127=0.
\]

Thus the complete stable interval is

\[
\left[\frac{u_*-\sqrt{u_*^2-4}}2,\,
      \frac{u_*+\sqrt{u_*^2-4}}2\right].
\]

At the lower endpoint \(r_-\), the parasitic period multiplier on the unit circle is

\[
-1.
\]

Therefore the requested final answer is

\[
\boxed{\operatorname{root}_{(6,7)}\!\left(4x^3-8x^2-95x-127\right)}.
\]
